entries.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
entries.title: brainstorming

entries.description: Use when a superpowers session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the superpowers maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.
entries.title: diagnosing-superpowers

entries.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
entries.title: dispatching-parallel-agents

entries.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
entries.title: executing-plans

entries.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
entries.title: finishing-a-development-branch

entries.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
entries.title: receiving-code-review

entries.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
entries.title: requesting-code-review

entries.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
entries.title: subagent-driven-development

entries.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
entries.title: systematic-debugging

entries.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
entries.title: test-driven-development

entries.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
entries.title: using-git-worktrees

entries.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
entries.title: using-superpowers

entries.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
entries.title: verification-before-completion

entries.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
entries.title: writing-plans

entries.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
entries.title: writing-skills

plugin_manifest.description: Core skills library for Claude Code: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques
plugin_manifest.name: superpowers
